title: Alternating Divisoriality of Prime Ideals along Infinite Chains of Bézout Domains
summary: A question posed in the literature asks whether the divisoriality of a prime can alternate indefinitely along an ascending chain of overrings of a Prüfer domain or a descending chain of same-quotient-field underrings, and what happens at the limit. We construct such chains with all finite-stage domains Bézout and show, in both directions, that the limit prime can be either divisorial or nondivisorial.
